answer: I did not run the job because it cannot work on garnet. I asked the IQM API for garnet's layout, which costs no credits. Garnet has 20 qubits, and garnet:mock also has 20. A 30-qubit GHZ circuit needs 30 qubits, so garnet cannot run it. I submitted no jobs and spent no credits. You can run a GHZ circuit with 20 or fewer qubits on garnet, or pick a machine that has at least 30 qubits.
